compute.note: Parameters: 96 from the method string (high confidence); the circuit code builds 96 one-parameter gates (SU2_symmetrized_square_6x4._get_dimerizarion_layers: 8 patterns x 12 pairs), which reproduces it. Iterations: 2000 = 1000 natural-gradient steps without symmetry projection, then 1000 continuing with the 96-element projector (n_iter default 1000; main.py is called twice and passes only lr). As published, Optimizer.optimize() ends with "return res.x" on the circuit object, which has no attribute x, so the first call exits with an AttributeError and "&&" would skip the symmetric run; the step counts are therefore what the code intends, not what it can be shown to have run, hence confidence low. Samples: 16384 = 2^14 shots per estimated quantity (--log2samples=14); every metric-tensor entry, connection, norm and energy-derivative term for every projector term is one binomial draw of that size, so shots per step are 16384 x (that count), not 16384. Provenance: the value entered VarBench in d634c4c (2022-10-02, Nikita Astrakhantsev); the program was added to methods in 6887677 (2024-08-10) ("wip: added the VQE simulator"; next commit "VQE simulator: dusted-off version runs"), so it is a later reconstruction. The VarBench SM (arXiv:2302.04919 Sec. S3 D) describes the ansatz and the natural-gradient update but no step count. No device or time is recorded. || Ruling 2026-09-24 (Tristan): samples null: 16384 is shots per estimated quantity, not configurations per optimisation step (DATA.md).
